name: proforma-brief
description: Build business case decision briefs through conversation. Describe your decision; Claude extracts variables, estimates ranges, drafts narrative, and populates a live four-act brief you can export.
long_description: ProForma Brief Builder turns a conversation into a structured decision artifact. Describe a make-vs-buy decision, a vendor evaluation, or any initiative with uncertain payoff — Claude identifies the key variables, assigns conservative/base/optimistic ranges, writes a payoff formula, and authors all four acts of a narrative brief. The brief updates live in your browser as Claude works. When you're done, export a standalone HTML file you can share with any stakeholder.

tools.name: ensure_app_running
tools.description: Start the ProForma web app and return its URL

tools.name: update_brief
tools.description: Set brief variables, formula, costs, and narrative content

tools.name: get_brief_computed
tools.description: Get computed scenario results: payback month and M24 net for low/base/high

tools.name: get_app_status
tools.description: Check if the web app is running and how much idle time remains

tools.name: extend_lifetime
tools.description: Extend the web app's idle timeout

tools.name: close_app
tools.description: Close the web app and free the port

prompts.name: new_brief
prompts.text: I want to build a business case brief for a decision I'm working on.
